guides.title: Water inlet problem
guides.description: The dishwasher is not getting enough water.
troubleshooting_steps: Check that the water tap is fully open.
Check whether the inlet hose is bent or kinked.
Clean the small filter or sieve in the hose connection.
Unplug the dishwasher for 1 to 2 minutes to reset it.
guides.claim_guidance: Mention that the dishwasher is not taking in water and add E1 if it appears on the display.
guides.optional_form_description: My Amica dishwasher is not taking in water and may show error code E1. I checked the water tap and inlet hose, but the issue remains. Please arrange a check or advise on the next step.

guides.title: Problema de entrada de agua
guides.description: El lavavajillas no recibe suficiente agua.
troubleshooting_steps: Comprueba que el grifo del agua esté completamente abierto.
Comprueba si la manguera de entrada está doblada o torcida.
Limpia el pequeño filtro o tamiz de la conexión de la manguera.
Desenchufa el lavavajillas durante 1 o 2 minutos para reiniciarlo.
guides.claim_guidance: Indica que el lavavajillas no toma agua y añade E1 si aparece en la pantalla.
guides.optional_form_description: Mi lavavajillas Amica no toma agua y puede mostrar el código de error E1. He comprobado el grifo del agua y la manguera de entrada, pero el problema continúa. Por favor, revisen el aparato o indíquenme el siguiente paso.

guides.title: Problem mit dem Wasserzulauf
guides.description: Der Geschirrspüler bekommt nicht genug Wasser.
troubleshooting_steps: Prüfen Sie, ob der Wasserhahn vollständig geöffnet ist.
Prüfen Sie, ob der Zulaufschlauch geknickt oder blockiert ist.
Reinigen Sie das kleine Sieb im Schlauchanschluss.
Ziehen Sie den Stecker für etwa 1 bis 2 Minuten, um das Gerät zurückzusetzen.
guides.claim_guidance: Geben Sie an, dass der Geschirrspüler kein Wasser zieht. Fügen Sie E1 hinzu, falls dieser Fehlercode angezeigt wird.
guides.optional_form_description: Mein Amica-Geschirrspüler zieht kein Wasser. E1 wird angezeigt. Ich habe den Wasserhahn und den Zulaufschlauch geprüft, aber das Problem besteht weiterhin. Bitte prüfen Sie das Gerät oder teilen Sie mir die nächsten Schritte mit.

guides.title: Heating or temperature problem
guides.description: The dishwasher is not heating properly and the water may stay cold.
troubleshooting_steps: Unplug the appliance for about 1 to 2 minutes to reset it.
Inspect the inside filters for dirt and buildup.
guides.claim_guidance: Mention that the dishwasher is not heating or the water stays cold, and add E3 if it appears on the display.
guides.optional_form_description: My Amica dishwasher is not heating properly and may show error code E3. The water stays cold and does not reach the required temperature. I reset the appliance and checked the filters, but the issue remains. Please arrange a check or advise on the next step.

guides.title: Problema de calentamiento o temperatura
guides.description: El lavavajillas no calienta bien y el agua puede quedarse fría.
troubleshooting_steps: Desenchufa el aparato durante 1 o 2 minutos para reiniciarlo.
Revisa los filtros interiores por si tienen suciedad o residuos.
guides.claim_guidance: Indica que el lavavajillas no calienta o que el agua sigue fría, y añade E3 si aparece en la pantalla.
guides.optional_form_description: Mi lavavajillas Amica no calienta bien y puede mostrar el código de error E3. El agua sigue fría y no alcanza la temperatura necesaria. He reiniciado el aparato y revisado los filtros, pero el problema continúa. Por favor, revisen el aparato o indíquenme el siguiente paso.

guides.title: Heiz- oder Temperaturproblem
guides.description: Der Geschirrspüler heizt nicht richtig und das Wasser kann kalt bleiben.
troubleshooting_steps: Ziehen Sie den Stecker für etwa 1 bis 2 Minuten, um das Gerät zurückzusetzen.
Prüfen Sie die Siebe im Innenraum auf Verschmutzungen.
guides.claim_guidance: Geben Sie an, dass der Geschirrspüler nicht richtig heizt oder das Wasser kalt bleibt. Fügen Sie E3 hinzu, falls dieser Fehlercode angezeigt wird.
guides.optional_form_description: Mein Amica-Geschirrspüler heizt nicht richtig. E3 wird angezeigt. Das Wasser bleibt kalt oder erreicht nicht die erforderliche Temperatur. Ich habe das Gerät zurückgesetzt und die Siebe geprüft, aber das Problem besteht weiterhin. Bitte prüfen Sie das Gerät oder teilen Sie mir die nächsten Schritte mit.

guides.title: Leak or overflow problem
guides.description: The appliance may have a leak or overflow issue and can keep pumping continuously.
troubleshooting_steps: If the unit keeps pumping even after power-off, check whether there is water in the base tray.
If it keeps pumping and there is water in the base tray, tilt the appliance slightly forward so the water can run out.
guides.claim_guidance: Mention that the dishwasher is leaking, keeps pumping, or there may be water in the base tray, and include a photo if possible.
guides.optional_form_description: My Amica dishwasher appears to have a leak or overflow problem and may show error code E4. The appliance keeps pumping and there may be water in the base tray. Please arrange a check or advise on the next step.

guides.title: Problema de fuga o desbordamiento
guides.description: El aparato puede tener una fuga o un problema de desbordamiento y puede seguir bombeando continuamente.
troubleshooting_steps: Si el aparato sigue bombeando incluso después de apagarlo, comprueba si hay agua en la bandeja inferior.
Si sigue bombeando y hay agua en la bandeja inferior, inclina el aparato ligeramente hacia delante para que el agua pueda salir.
guides.claim_guidance: Indica que el lavavajillas pierde agua, sigue bombeando o que puede haber agua en la bandeja inferior, y adjunta una foto si es posible.
guides.optional_form_description: Mi lavavajillas Amica parece tener una fuga o un problema de desbordamiento y puede mostrar el código de error E4. El aparato sigue bombeando y puede haber agua en la bandeja inferior. Por favor, revisen el aparato o indíquenme el siguiente paso.

guides.title: Leck- oder Überlaufproblem
guides.description: Das Gerät kann undicht sein oder ein Überlaufproblem haben und dauerhaft weiterpumpen.
troubleshooting_steps: Wenn das Gerät auch nach dem Ausschalten weiterpumpt, prüfen Sie, ob sich Wasser in der Bodenwanne befindet.
Wenn es weiterpumpt und Wasser in der Bodenwanne steht, kippen Sie das Gerät leicht nach vorne, damit das Wasser ablaufen kann.
guides.claim_guidance: Geben Sie an, dass der Geschirrspüler undicht ist, dauerhaft pumpt oder Wasser in der Bodenwanne sein könnte. Fügen Sie E4 hinzu, falls dieser Fehlercode angezeigt wird.
guides.optional_form_description: Mein Amica-Geschirrspüler scheint undicht zu sein oder ein Überlaufproblem zu haben. E4 wird angezeigt. Das Gerät pumpt dauerhaft oder es könnte sich Wasser in der Bodenwanne befinden. Bitte prüfen Sie das Gerät oder teilen Sie mir die nächsten Schritte mit.

guides.title: Water drainage problem
guides.description: The dishwasher is not draining properly and water may stay inside.
troubleshooting_steps: Clean the internal filters.
Check the drain hose for blockages or kinks.
Check the pump area for blockages.
Unplug the appliance for about 1 to 2 minutes to reset it.
guides.claim_guidance: Mention that the dishwasher is not draining properly, and add E02 if it appears on the display.
guides.optional_form_description: My Amica dishwasher is not draining properly and may show error code E02. I checked the filters, drain hose, and pump area, but the issue remains. Please arrange a check or advise on the next step.

guides.title: Problema de desagüe
guides.description: El lavavajillas no desagua bien y puede quedar agua dentro.
troubleshooting_steps: Limpia los filtros interiores.
Comprueba si la manguera de desagüe tiene obstrucciones o dobleces.
Comprueba si hay obstrucciones en la zona de la bomba.
Desenchufa el aparato durante 1 o 2 minutos para reiniciarlo.
guides.claim_guidance: Indica que el lavavajillas no desagua bien y añade E02 si aparece en la pantalla.
guides.optional_form_description: Mi lavavajillas Amica no desagua bien y puede mostrar el código de error E02. He revisado los filtros, la manguera de desagüe y la zona de la bomba, pero el problema continúa. Por favor, revisen el aparato o indíquenme el siguiente paso.

guides.title: Problem mit dem Wasserablauf
guides.description: Der Geschirrspüler pumpt nicht richtig ab und Wasser kann im Gerät stehen bleiben.
troubleshooting_steps: Reinigen Sie die Innensiebe.
Prüfen Sie den Ablaufschlauch auf Verstopfungen oder Knicke.
Prüfen Sie den Pumpenbereich auf Verstopfungen.
Ziehen Sie den Stecker für etwa 1 bis 2 Minuten, um das Gerät zurückzusetzen.
guides.claim_guidance: Geben Sie an, dass der Geschirrspüler nicht abpumpt. Fügen Sie E02 hinzu, falls dieser Fehlercode angezeigt wird.
guides.optional_form_description: Mein Amica-Geschirrspüler pumpt nicht richtig ab. E02 wird angezeigt. Ich habe die Siebe, den Ablaufschlauch und den Pumpenbereich geprüft, aber das Problem besteht weiterhin. Bitte prüfen Sie das Gerät oder teilen Sie mir die nächsten Schritte mit.

guides.title: Cooling problem
guides.description: The fridge is not cooling enough and food may get warm.
troubleshooting_steps: Check the temperature setting.
Make sure the door closes fully.
Keep the ventilation gaps clear.
Wait several hours with the door closed to see if cooling improves.
guides.claim_guidance: Mention that the fridge stays warm or does not cool properly.
guides.optional_form_description: My architecto fridge is not cooling properly. I checked the temperature setting, the door closure, and the ventilation gaps, but the issue remains. Please arrange a check or advise on the next step.

guides.title: Freezing problem
guides.description: The freezer is not freezing properly and food may start to defrost.
troubleshooting_steps: Check the temperature setting.
Check whether the door was left open.
Keep the ventilation gaps clear.
guides.claim_guidance: Mention that the freezer stays warm or cannot hold temperature.
guides.optional_form_description: My architecto freezer is not freezing properly. I checked the temperature setting, the door, and the ventilation gaps, but the issue remains. Please arrange a check or advise on the next step.

guides.title: Oven not heating
guides.description: The oven is not heating or does not get hot enough.
troubleshooting_steps: Check the selected mode and temperature.
Test another heating mode if available.
guides.claim_guidance: Mention that the oven does not heat even though the controls are set correctly.
guides.optional_form_description: My architecto oven is not heating properly. I checked the selected mode and temperature and tested another heating mode, but the issue remains. Please arrange a check or advise on the next step.

guides.title: Hob display error
guides.description: The hob is showing a flashing error or other display code.
troubleshooting_steps: Take a photo of the display.
Switch the hob off and restart it once.
guides.claim_guidance: Mention the exact error code or attach a display photo.
guides.optional_form_description: My architecto hob shows an error or flashing code on the display. I switched it off and restarted it, but the error remains. Please arrange a check or advise on the next step.

guides.title: Gas smell
guides.description: There is a gas smell near the gas hob.
troubleshooting_steps: Stop using the appliance immediately.
Ventilate the room.
Close the gas supply if it is safe to do so.
guides.claim_guidance: Escalate immediately. Do not continue using the appliance.
guides.optional_form_description: There is a gas smell near my architecto gas hob. I stopped using the appliance and ventilated the room. Please arrange urgent assistance immediately.

guides.title: Weak extractor suction
guides.description: The extractor hood has weak or no suction.
troubleshooting_steps: Check that the filters are inserted and clean.
Test different speed levels.
guides.claim_guidance: Mention that suction remains weak after checking the filters.
guides.optional_form_description: My architecto extractor hood has weak or no suction. I checked that the filters are fitted and clean and tested different speed levels, but the issue remains. Please arrange a check or advise on the next step.

guides.title: Sparks inside the microwave
guides.description: The microwave is sparking or flashing inside.
troubleshooting_steps: Stop using the microwave immediately.
Remove any metal item if present.
Do not continue testing.
guides.claim_guidance: Create a claim immediately and attach photos if possible.
guides.optional_form_description: My architecto microwave is sparking or flashing inside. I stopped using it immediately. Please arrange an urgent check or advise on the next step.

guides.title: Washing machine leak
guides.description: Water is leaking from the washing machine.
troubleshooting_steps: Stop using the appliance.
Turn off the water tap if it is safe.
Take photos of the leak area.
guides.claim_guidance: Create a claim immediately and attach photos of the leak.
guides.optional_form_description: My architecto washing machine is leaking water. I stopped using it, turned off the water tap where safe, and took photos of the leak. Please arrange an urgent check or advise on the next step.

guides.title: Washer-dryer not drying
guides.description: The washer-dryer finishes but the clothes stay wet after the drying cycle.
troubleshooting_steps: Check the selected drying programme.
Check the load size.
Clean the accessible filter if the model has one.
guides.claim_guidance: Mention that drying still does not work after normal checks.
guides.optional_form_description: My architecto washer-dryer is not drying properly and the clothes remain wet after the drying cycle. I checked the programme, the load size, and the accessible filter, but the issue remains. Please arrange a check or advise on the next step.

guides.title: Burning smell from the dryer
guides.description: There is a strong burning smell or smoke coming from the tumble dryer.
troubleshooting_steps: Stop using the dryer immediately.
Unplug it if it is safe.
Check only the visible lint filter after it cools.
guides.claim_guidance: Create a claim immediately, especially if there is smoke or a strong smell.
guides.optional_form_description: My architecto tumble dryer has a strong burning smell or smoke. I stopped using it immediately. Please arrange urgent assistance or advise on the next step.

guides.title: Condensation or water inside the wine cooler
guides.description: Condensation or water is building up inside the wine cooler.
troubleshooting_steps: Check whether the door closes properly.
Consider room humidity.
Take photos if water returns.
guides.claim_guidance: Mention that condensation or water returns and whether cooling is also affected.
guides.optional_form_description: My architecto wine cooler has condensation or water building up inside. I checked the door closure and the surrounding conditions, but the issue remains. Please arrange a check or advise on the next step.
